  - generic: 简短介绍（100-150 个英文单词）
  - textbox "简短介绍（100-150 个英文单词）": JevPlay is an independent browser playground for free daily decision games against TypeSafe Jev. Each challenge gives the human and Jev the same seed, state, rules, and legal actions. The player moves first while Jev's exact route stays hidden; the server checks and scores every action, then reveals a side-by-side replay when the run is complete. Current games include Code Breaker, Word Ladder, Dungeon Crawler, and Snake Challenge, covering logic, word transformation, strategy, and reflexes. Guests can play without an account; sign in only to save a leaderboard score. Completed results show the actual provider and decision evidence, and a failed Jev request is labeled Practice Bot instead of inventing a result. JevPlay is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TypeSafe.
  - generic: 详细介绍（250-500 个英文单词）
  - textbox "详细介绍（250-500 个英文单词）": JevPlay is an independent browser playground for free daily decision games that let people compare their choices with TypeSafe Jev. Every challenge starts from a shared seed, state, rules, and legal-action set. The human plays first while the opponent's exact path stays hidden. The server validates each action, locks the human score, and then reveals the completed paths in a replay so the comparison can be inspected instead of relying on a staged example. The current game directory includes Code Breaker, Word Ladder, Dungeon Crawler, and Snake Challenge. Code Breaker asks players to solve a four-symbol code in up to eight guesses. Word Ladder changes one letter at a time to reach a target word. Dungeon Crawler is a seeded strategy route with legal actions, survival, loot, and efficiency metrics. Snake Challenge uses a shared board and food order, with every move checked by the server. The games are designed for short daily sessions and expose the comparison metrics for each challenge. No account is required to complete a game. A user can sign in to save a score to the daily leaderboard. Finished runs show the recorded opponent identity and decision evidence; if TypeSafe Jev cannot return a valid action, the result is explicitly labeled Practice Bot rather than fabricating an AI score. JevPlay also includes a Chat Intent Analyzer that sends a short conversation to Jev and returns structured estimates such as likely intent, reply urgency, risk, tone, and a recommended next action with visible probabilities. JevPlay is free to start and currently has no paid plan or checkout. It is an independent community project, not an official TypeSafe product or endorsement. The site is intended for people who want to play decision games, inspect server-verified AI behavior, and learn how structured decision systems can be used in interactive tools.

  - generic: 简短介绍（100-150 个英文单词）
  - textbox "简短介绍（100-150 个英文单词）": JevPlay is an independent browser playground for free daily decision games against TypeSafe Jev. Each challenge gives the human and Jev the same seed, state, rules, and legal actions. The player moves first while Jev's exact route stays hidden; the server checks and scores every action, then reveals a side-by-side replay when the run is complete. Current games include Code Breaker, Word Ladder, Dungeon Crawler, and Snake Challenge, covering logic, word transformation, strategy, and reflexes. Guests can play without an account; sign in only to save a leaderboard score. Completed results show the actual provider and decision evidence, and a failed Jev request is labeled Practice Bot instead of inventing a result. JevPlay is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TypeSafe.
  - generic: 详细介绍（250-500 个英文单词）
  - textbox "详细介绍（250-500 个英文单词）": JevPlay is an independent browser playground for free daily decision games that let people compare their choices with TypeSafe Jev. Every challenge starts from a shared seed, state, rules, and legal-action set. The human plays first while the opponent's exact path stays hidden. The server validates each action, locks the human score, and then reveals the completed paths in a replay so the comparison can be inspected instead of relying on a staged example. The current game directory includes Code Breaker, Word Ladder, Dungeon Crawler, and Snake Challenge. Code Breaker asks players to solve a four-symbol code in up to eight guesses. Word Ladder changes one letter at a time to reach a target word. Dungeon Crawler is a seeded strategy route with legal actions, survival, loot, and efficiency metrics. Snake Challenge uses a shared board and food order, with every move checked by the server. The games are designed for short daily sessions and expose the comparison metrics for each challenge. No account is required to complete a game. A user can sign in to save a score to the daily leaderboard. Finished runs show the recorded opponent identity and decision evidence; if TypeSafe Jev cannot return a valid action, the result is explicitly labeled Practice Bot rather than fabricating an AI score. JevPlay also includes a Chat Intent Analyzer that sends a short conversation to Jev and returns structured estimates such as likely intent, reply urgency, risk, tone, and a recommended next action with visible probabilities. JevPlay is free to start and currently has no paid plan or checkout. It is an independent community project, not an official TypeSafe product or endorsement. The site is intended for people who want to play decision games, inspect server-verified AI behavior, and learn how structured decision systems can be used in interactive tools.
